LanguageData.RHAH_RemovalDisabled: This save no longer starts new Hunger and Havoc content. Event follow-ups and pending predator arrivals are stopped. Save once more before that state is in the original file. Event records, visitors, letters, and places already here stay. The global switch is unchanged.
LanguageData.RHAH_RemovalExport: Back up and export a removal copy
LanguageData.RHAH_RemovalConfirm:
The game will pause and save a backup of its current state. It then turns off this save's new content and event follow-ups and saves a cleaned copy. The original file is not overwritten.

The cleaned copy changes ratkin kinds, histories, hidden factions, and the storyteller. It removes this mod's traits, genes, health conditions, memories, items, zones, letters, quests in progress, and event records. The people stay. Oxygen DSL Framework and other mods' event records stay.

After it succeeds, quit, remove only this mod, and keep the ratkin mod, Harmony, Biotech, and Oxygen DSL Framework. Restart and load the cleaned copy. The world still running is not cleaned. An unknown reference stops the export. Continue?
LanguageData.RHAH_RemovalFailed:
The cleaned export did not finish. Do not remove the mod because of it.
